_description: The agent to user citation token, read back from the text an agent wrote: `#kind:uuid` — a data kind and a canonical 36-character id that stands on its own. The two readers must agree: the backend's `refs::cite::cited_refs` and the frontend's `findRefTokens` (`src/utils/messageRefs.ts`), which also feeds `remarkCiteRefs`. A token keeps its power only in the agent's prose: not inside an inline code span or a fenced block, not glued to a word, never an actor kind ('@' is the actor sigil), never a malformed id — and a token the server has made inert (a U+2060 WORD JOINER before the sigil) is nobody's citation. This file is a byte-for-byte copy on both sides (`backend/tests/fixtures/refs/cited_tokens.json` and `frontend/src/refs/__fixtures__/cited_tokens.json`); both sides test against it.

cited.why: the agent names a plan inside a sentence
two kinds, in order of appearance
a token opened by a bracket is still a token
a closed inline span does not reach further
a closed fence does not reach further

not_cited.why: a fenced block is not prose
a sigil glued to a word is prose
a kind the server does not list
the nil id is not an entity
a token the server made inert is nobody's citation
